canon.entry: An independent Civil Verifier receives a family mandate for the recent death of Elias Rook.
canon.truth: P5_PRIVATE_SECOND_DEATH: Elias sustained a continuous household identity after a valid Eastbank death registration. Both record chains are authentic; the cause of their incompatibility remains unresolved.
stakes: Integrity of old and current death records
canon.anomaly: Identity Contradiction; Name, Memory and Witness
evidenceGraph: Current death and insurance continuity support recent identity
Old registration and police-held certified extract support old death
Family testimony concerns lived continuity, not complete causation
pressures: Family appointment on day two; missing it strains continuity but does not erase evidence
routes: Civil register or police certified extract
Family testimony and optional professional consultation
interventions: Preserve both versions without adjudicating hidden causation
Report, challenge, protect family, notify specialists or abandon
consequences: Official position differs from historical Truth
canon.eastbankContribution: Administrative Error layer only; no deliberate stabilization revelation
revelationPredicates: Authentic identity chains conflict; no higher revelation predicate

canon.orderSafety: Routes can be taken in any order and each record chain has an alternative custodian.
canon.failureContinuity: Denied private access offers a public certified route; wrong theories never change evidence and imperfect dispositions remain playable.

perspective.publicDescription: A newly deceased client appears in a valid Eastbank death register from approximately forty years ago. The family asks you to keep both documents separate.
